verdict.rationale: Runpod advertises GPUs across '30+ regions' and distinguishes Secure Cloud (T3/T4 data centers) vs Community Cloud, implying some ability to pick a compute location, but there is no explicit documentation of selecting a specific region/data-residency guarantee for storage or network volumes. missing for 10: explicit region-selection UI/API for deployments, documented data-residency/compliance controls for stored data, independent confirmation that chosen region persists for storage.
